objective: Wire explicit DigitalOcean Spaces (S3-compatible) endpoint, region, and static credentials into S3Adapter, and make production validation fail closed when any are missing or malformed.
hard_domain_exclusion: ADR-038 section 6: credential handling, endpoint/region wiring, and fail-closed production validation are auth/credential and governance-invariant surface, cloud-only regardless of measured cyclomatic complexity.
interface_contract: This cloud tramo owns the endpoint_url and region field names/shapes on StorageSettings and StorageConfig. A separate Low-band local tramo adds literal 'endpoint' and 'region' TOML keys under [storage] in config/production.toml and config/staging.toml, matching these field names exactly. Field names must not be renamed after this refinement without re-freezing the interface.
current_config_production_toml_storage_s:
backend = "s3"
base_path = ""
bucket = "dubbridge-production"
// no endpoint or region keys present yet
acceptance_criteria: StorageSettings carries region and credential references; secrets are env-only and absent from config/*.toml.
S3Adapter::new sets bucket, endpoint, region, and static credentials explicitly.

AppConfig::validate() rejects an s3 backend that is missing endpoint, region, or credentials, AND rejects malformed/empty values for those fields (schema validity, not just presence) -- per Gemma's phase-1 review note.
A real round-trip (put then get) against an S3-compatible endpoint is executed and recorded; a unit test alone does not satisfy this.
The existing local MinIO path keeps working unchanged with the same configuration shape.
Credentials never appear in configuration files, logs, or traces -- only injected DUBBRIDGE_* environment variables carry them (ADR-026 Decision 4, ADR-018 redaction).
gemma_phase1_note: Ensure AppConfig::validate() covers both presence and schema validity of endpoint/region to fully satisfy EC-1.
stop_conditions_hint: Stop after producing round-trip evidence against a real S3-compatible endpoint. Do not touch the upload path or key layout. Do not start any task beyond S-230-T1.
